(As in, instead of requiring a backpack and putting things into it, to allow containers like Item Cases to be the first thing, mostly just as a roleplay thing of “getting deliveries”)

I’ve tried expanding the pockets with SVM to fit only cases and fill them that way but it doesn’t register them as being there, only if they’re in an equipped piece of gear like backpacks or things that, i assume, can be taken into raid in vanilla
